description: Send a draft (owner or admin token only, and never without the user's explicit yes). A draft blocked by its last review cannot be approved until it is fixed and reviewed again. `translations` makes the translated draft in each linked project in the same call (see viralhunt_translate_post). Returns {status, results, warnings, translations[]}.

allow_duplicate.description: Only when the user wants a second copy on purpose: the duplicate firewall otherwise refuses an account another post of the last 72 hours already carries the same text for (409 duplicate_post when every account is one). A status processing with checking=true means every network was cut and PostProxy is being checked: never approve or create the post again.

name: viralhunt_approve_draft
